svg.title: ShadowsLunarfox/Custom-Hierarchy-for-Unity
svg.desc: Custom-Hierarchy for unity Custom Hierarchy is a Unity Editor extension for improving the Hierarchy window. It adds component icons, object colors, connection line colors, name colors, custom icons, and a management palette so scene objects are easier to identify and organize. C#; 5 stars; 0 forks.

g.font-family: Segoe UI, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif
